marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:

to east 30 Friday afternoon. Wind increasing to east 35 Friday
evening. Scattered flurries ending Friday morning. Flurries Friday
evening. Temperatures minus 7 rising to minus 2 Friday
afternoon. Freezing spray beginning Friday evening. <br/>
